description: nf-core/bacass samplesheet context, aligned to the pinned 2.6.1 nextflow_schema.json and assets/schema_input.json. Bacterial ISOLATE assembly and annotation.

assembly_type.help: REQUIRED — bacass has no default and error()s without it. 'short' is the curated value because NExtSEEK holds no long-read data at all; change it only for a genuinely long-read or hybrid cohort.

assembler.help: Assembler to run. The pipeline default is the full list of eight; that is a benchmarking default and would run all of them. Pinned here to unicycler, the standard choice for short-read isolates.

annotation_tool.help: prokka needs no external database. bakta does (--baktadb), and none is provisioned on Luria.

skip_kraken2.help: TRUE by curated default: Kraken2 read classification needs a database (--kraken2db) that Luria does not host.

skip_kmerfinder.help: TRUE by curated default: the KmerFinder contamination check needs --kmerfinderdb, not provisioned.

pipeline.name: nf-core/bacass
pipeline.core_rule: Columns are ID, R1, R2, LongFastQ, Fast5, GenomeSize. Only ID is required by the schema, but a short-read assembly needs R1 (and R2 for paired). NOTE the non-standard names: this pipeline does NOT use sample/fastq_1/fastq_2.
pipeline.reference_requirement: NONE. It assembles de novo. The 2.6.1 schema declares no genome/fasta/gtf parameter at all; an optional reference_fasta/reference_gff pair exists for the liftoff annotation route only.

validation_rules: The sample column is named ID; the read columns are R1 and R2. Emitting sample/fastq_1/fastq_2 will fail validation.
assembly_type must be set. bacass declares no default and aborts at validation without it; 'short' is curated here because we hold no long-read data.
Do NOT pass --genome, --fasta or --gtf: the 2.6.1 schema declares none of them.
Leave assembler at a single value. The pipeline's own default lists eight assemblers and would run every one of them.
Keep skip_kraken2 and skip_kmerfinder true unless a database path is supplied — both fail with no database.
This is for ISOLATES: one bacterial genome per sample. A metagenomic library sent here produces a meaningless chimeric assembly, not an error — use mag instead.
LongFastQ/Fast5 are for hybrid or long-read assembly. NExtSEEK holds no long-read data, so leave them blank.
notes: NO MATCHING DATA IN NExtSEEK as of 2026-08-05. Bacterial isolate sequencing does not exist here: the 1,402 BAC samples have zero D.SEQ children, and the 3,975 mycobacterium/TB mentions sit on host samples (MUS, PAV, PAT, NHP) — infected animals and patients, not sequenced isolates. Catalogued so the capability exists when an isolate cohort is registered. Verify the cohort really is isolate sequencing before launching.

sources.label: nf-core/bacass nextflow_schema.json @ 2.6.1
sources.notes: Authoritative: no required params beyond input/outdir; no genome/fasta/gtf; assembler defaults to a list of eight.

sources.label: nf-core/bacass assets/schema_input.json @ 2.6.1
sources.notes: Authoritative columns: ID required; R1, R2, LongFastQ, Fast5, GenomeSize optional.

samplesheet_columns.description: Column-level field dictionary for the nf-core/bacass input sheet.

R1.validation_hints: Absolute Luria path from the sample's primary-data metadata.

LongFastQ.validation_hints: Leave blank — no long-read data exists in NExtSEEK.

GenomeSize.description: Estimated genome size, used by some assemblers.
GenomeSize.validation_hints: Only for long-read/hybrid routes; leave blank otherwise.

report_writer_guidance.purpose: Build an nf-core/bacass sheet from a resolved D.SEQ cohort of bacterial isolate libraries.
report_writer_guidance.workflow_role: Selected when the user asks to assemble or annotate bacterial genomes from isolate sequencing.
population_priority: First confirm the cohort is ISOLATE sequencing, not amplicon or metagenomic. NExtSEEK currently holds none, so expect to have to ask.
One row per D.SEQ leaf; ID = the UID; R1/R2 from primary-data metadata.
Leave LongFastQ, Fast5 and GenomeSize blank.
final_checks: assembler is a single value, not the eight-item default.
